tolerances.curveReason: Triangulated circular surface approximates the continuous semicylinder; preserve measured residual rather than accept ideal normal as actual geometry.

limits: Ideal relay checked for finite visual bounds only; no real thick-lens prescription or aberration claim.

Fresnel fractions combine the glass/contact/sample incoherent multiple-reflection series; drawn lines are representative routes, not all physical multiple-reflection paths. Whole-instrument coating/absorption remains excluded.
Reticle mathematical tick marks excluded from opaque obstruction list; transparent reticle is a teaching overlay.
Physical sample and manufacturer internal geometry remain uncalibrated.
method: independent direct GLB parse, numpy world triangles, finite face projection, vector Snell/reflection, Moller-Trumbore intersections; no author optics or Blender imports
